intro: Whether it's a wedding, birthday, corporate event or festival — find out what's included, how it works, and send us an enquiry.
included_intro: A standard Tennessee Whiskey booking is a 2-hour live performance, typically split as two 1-hour sets with a short break in between. During the break we'll play music through the PA to keep the atmosphere going.
included_items: Music played through the PA between sets
Special requests learned with enough notice
Invoice & contract provided for every booking

how_it_works.title: Send us an enquiry
how_it_works.desc: Fill in the form with your event details — date, venue, type of event and anything else useful. We'll get back to you within 48 hours.

how_it_works.title: We confirm the details
how_it_works.desc: Once we've discussed your event and agreed everything, we'll put together a contract and invoice so everything is clear and confirmed in writing.

how_it_works.title: Deposit to secure your date
how_it_works.desc: A deposit secures your date in the diary. The remaining balance is due closer to the event.

how_it_works.title: We show up and play
how_it_works.desc: On the night, we handle everything — setup, sound, lighting, and of course the music. You just enjoy it.
